learner_summary: Internal task state records whether arrival/finishing conditions have been met; COMPLETE can remain airborne.
clarifications: Native C++ decides completion from estimated position/velocity and dwell; GCS reports it rather than commanding completion.
Horizontal speed is aircraft translation, not propeller RPM; powered hover can have zero horizontal/vertical speed.
RUNNING/DWELLING continue approach/arrival checks; COMPLETE retains hold; operator LAND remains separate.
No AI model or automatic next-task dispatch exists in L11.
assessment_limit: Guided explanation, not an independent examination.
